name: Explicit Radon Transform Analysis
aliases: Sparse-View Radon Transform Null Space Analysis
definition: Construction and analysis of the explicit Radon transform matrix $A$ for different scanning geometries (sparse angles vs. limited angles) to analyze the singular values $W$ and the structure of the forward operator.
summary: Explicit Radon Transform Analysis constructs the forward projection matrix to diagnose tomographic invertibility via singular values and null space identification, distinguishing itself from black-box differentiable rendering.
